groups.title: Question Detectives
groups.description: Ask what, who, where, when, why and how

groups.title: Where Is It?
groups.description: Find things around, above, and below

groups.title: Here & There
groups.description: Talk about things close and far

groups.title: Time & Places
groups.description: Learn at, before, after and now

lessons.title: What
lessons.teach: We use WHAT to ask about a thing.

challenge.prompt: You see a surprise in a bag. Which word asks about the thing?
challenge.explain: WHAT asks about things.

transfer.explain: Ask WHAT to name a thing.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: What is …

lessons.title: Who
lessons.teach: We use WHO to ask about a person.

challenge.prompt: A friend is at the door. Which word asks about the person?
challenge.explain: WHO asks about people.

transfer.explain: WHO asks which person is singing.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: Who is …

lessons.title: Where
lessons.teach: We use WHERE to ask about a place.

challenge.prompt: Your ball is missing. Which word asks about its place?
challenge.explain: WHERE asks about places.

transfer.explain: WHERE asks about the place you live.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: Where is …

lessons.title: When
lessons.teach: We use WHEN to ask about time.

challenge.prompt: You want to know the time of lunch. What do you ask?
challenge.explain: WHEN asks about time.

transfer.explain: WHEN is used for a time question.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: When do …

lessons.title: Why
lessons.teach: We use WHY to ask for a reason.

challenge.prompt: You want to know the reason the ground is wet.
challenge.explain: WHY asks for a reason.

transfer.explain: WHY asks for the reason.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: Why is …

lessons.title: How
lessons.teach: We use HOW to ask about the way to do something.
lessons.example: How do I fly a kite?

challenge.prompt: You want to learn the way to fly a kite.
challenge.explain: HOW asks about the way something happens.

transfer.prompt: ___ do we make a paper boat?
transfer.explain: HOW asks how to make something.

lessons.sentence: How do I fly a kite?
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: How do …

lessons.title: In
lessons.teach: IN means inside something.
lessons.example: The ball is in the box.

challenge.prompt: Look at the ball. Where is it?
challenge.explain: The ball is inside the box.

transfer.explain: IN means inside.

lessons.sentence: The ball is in the box.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The ball …

lessons.title: On
lessons.teach: ON means touching the top of something.
lessons.example: The ball is on the box.

challenge.prompt: Look at the ball. Where is it?
challenge.explain: The ball touches the top.

transfer.explain: The book touches the table.

lessons.sentence: The ball is on the box.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The ball …

lessons.title: Under
lessons.teach: UNDER means beneath something.
lessons.example: The ball is under the table.

challenge.prompt: Look at the ball. Where is it?
challenge.explain: The ball is directly beneath the table.

transfer.explain: UNDER means beneath.

lessons.sentence: The ball is under the table.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The ball …

lessons.title: Above
lessons.teach: ABOVE means higher than something.
lessons.example: The bird is above the tree.

challenge.prompt: Where is the bird in the picture?
challenge.explain: The bird flies higher than the tree.

transfer.explain: ABOVE means higher than.

lessons.sentence: The bird is above the tree.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The bird …

lessons.title: Below
lessons.teach: BELOW means lower than something.
lessons.example: The toy is below the shelf.

challenge.prompt: Where is the toy?
challenge.explain: The toy is lower than the shelf.

transfer.prompt: The shoes are ___ the hanging coats.
transfer.explain: BELOW means lower than.

lessons.sentence: The toy is below the shelf.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The toy …

lessons.title: Next to
lessons.teach: NEXT TO means right beside something.
lessons.example: The cat is next to the box.

challenge.prompt: Where is the cat?
challenge.explain: The cat is beside the box.

transfer.explain: NEXT TO means beside.

lessons.sentence: The cat is next to the box.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The cat …

lessons.title: Between
lessons.teach: BETWEEN means in the middle of two things.
lessons.example: The ball is between two boxes.

challenge.prompt: Where is the ball?
options: In the middle of two boxes
challenge.explain: BETWEEN means in the middle.

transfer.prompt: The girl stands ___ her two friends.
transfer.explain: BETWEEN is used with two sides.

lessons.sentence: The ball is between two boxes.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The ball …

lessons.title: Behind
lessons.teach: BEHIND means at the back of something.
lessons.example: The cat is behind the tree.

challenge.prompt: Where is the cat?
challenge.explain: The tree is in front of the cat.

transfer.explain: BEHIND means at the back.

lessons.sentence: The cat is behind the tree.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The cat …

lessons.title: In front of
lessons.teach: IN FRONT OF means on the forward side of something.
lessons.example: The cat is in front of the tree.

challenge.prompt: Where is the cat?
challenge.explain: The cat can be seen before the tree.

transfer.explain: IN FRONT OF means ahead of.

lessons.sentence: The cat is in front of the tree.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The cat …

lessons.title: Near
lessons.teach: NEAR means not far away.
lessons.example: The tree is near the house.

challenge.prompt: Where is the tree?
challenge.explain: The tree is close to the house.

transfer.explain: NEAR means close.

lessons.sentence: The tree is near the house.
lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The tree …

lessons.title: Here
lessons.teach: HERE means this place, close to me.

challenge.prompt: A toy is beside you. What can you say?
challenge.explain: HERE is close to the speaker.

transfer.explain: HERE means near me.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: My book …

lessons.title: There
lessons.teach: THERE means that place, away from me.

challenge.prompt: You point to a kite far away. What do you say?
challenge.explain: THERE is away from the speaker.

transfer.explain: THERE points to a far place.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: The kite …

lessons.title: This
lessons.teach: THIS points to one thing close to you.

challenge.prompt: You hold a ball in your hands. Which word fits?
challenge.explain: THIS is one thing near you.

transfer.prompt: ___ apple in my hand is red.
transfer.explain: THIS points to one nearby thing.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: This is …

lessons.title: That
lessons.teach: THAT points to one thing far away.

challenge.prompt: You point to a tree far away. Which word fits?
challenge.explain: THAT is one thing farther away.

transfer.prompt: ___ kite in the sky is blue.
transfer.explain: THAT points to one faraway thing.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: That is …

lessons.title: At
lessons.teach: AT tells an exact place or a time.

challenge.prompt: You are sitting in your classroom. What can you say?
challenge.explain: AT can name your location.

transfer.explain: AT is used with a clock time.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: We are …

lessons.title: Before
lessons.teach: BEFORE means earlier than something.

challenge.prompt: What should you do first?
challenge.explain: BEFORE means earlier.

transfer.explain: We brush before bed.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: We wash …

lessons.title: After
lessons.teach: AFTER means later than something.

challenge.prompt: You eat lunch and then go outside. When do you play?
challenge.explain: AFTER means later.

transfer.prompt: I put away my toys ___ playing.
transfer.explain: AFTER is later.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: We play …

lessons.title: Now
lessons.teach: NOW means at this moment.

challenge.prompt: You are reading right this moment. What time word fits?
challenge.explain: NOW means at this very moment.

transfer.explain: NOW means this moment.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: I am …

lessons.title: A
lessons.teach: We put A before one thing that starts with a consonant sound.

challenge.prompt: Which is the correct phrase?
challenge.explain: BALL starts with a /b/ sound, so we say a ball.

transfer.explain: A comes before the /p/ sound in pet.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: I see …

lessons.title: An
lessons.teach: We put AN before one thing that starts with a vowel sound.

challenge.prompt: Which is the correct phrase?
challenge.explain: APPLE starts with a vowel sound, so we say an apple.

transfer.explain: EGG starts with a vowel sound.

lessons.hint: Put the words in order to make: I see …
